_meta.author: c2j
_meta.review_notes: Q48 (SELECT film_id, title FROM film WHERE title LIKE '%Action%' LIMIT 10) produces Limit -> Seq Scan on film with Filter: (title ~~ '%Action%'::text) and Rows Removed by Filter: 1000. TYPE-004 fires on the SeqScan node: Filter value contains substring "~~ '%" (rule also matches LIKE/like variants). extract_like_pattern regex (?:LIKE|like|~~)\s+'([^']+)' captures pattern = '%Action%'. is_double_sided = true (starts AND ends with '%', len > 1). detail = t!('finding.TYPE-004.detail', pattern='%Action%') concatenated with t!('finding.TYPE-004.detail_double_sided') = "Filter condition contains leading wildcard LIKE '%Action%', cannot use B-tree index (wildcards on both sides)". suggestion = t!('finding.TYPE-004.suggestion_double') mentioning pg_trgm + GIN index and full text search. severity=Warning, category=TypeMismatch. SCAN-004 co-fires on the same SeqScan: actual.rows=0 (Limit-truncated), rows_removed=1000 > min_rows_removed threshold (500) so should_fire=true. filter_cols regex captures column 'title' from 'title ~~ %Action%'. detail includes relation=film and Rows Removed by Filter: 1000. suggestion = suggestion_with_cols: ANALYZE film; also consider CREATE INDEX ON film (title). SCAN-001 does NOT fire (has Filter -> bails immediately; SCAN-001 is for pure full scans). TYPE-001 does NOT fire (extract_column_from_filter requires '=' operator; Q48 filter has '~~' not '=', returns None at column extraction). SCAN-005 does NOT fire (only matches IndexScan/IndexOnlyScan/PartitionedIndexScan/CStoreIndexScan; Q48 is SeqScan). GEN-001 does NOT fire (depth=2 < default threshold 10).

anti_findings.reason: SCAN-001 only fires on pure full scans (no Filter property); filtered scans are delegated to SCAN-004. Q48's SeqScan has Filter (title ~~ '%Action%'::text), so SCAN-001 bails at scan_rules.rs:53-55.

TYPE-001 (SuspectedImplicitTypeCast) requires extract_column_from_filter to find a 'col = value' pattern (regex at utils.rs:177-180 requires '=' operator). Q48 filter uses '~~' (LIKE) with no '=', so column extraction returns None and TYPE-001 bails.
SCAN-005 (IndexScanPoorSelectivity) only matches IndexScan / IndexOnlyScan / PartitionedIndexScan / CStoreIndexScan. Q48 is a SeqScan.
GEN-001 (PlanTooDeep) fires when plan depth exceeds max_plan_depth (default 10). Q48 depth = 2 (Limit -> SeqScan).
